steps: Mix flour, ginger, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Knead until a smooth, pliable dough forms.
Rest the dough to relax the gluten.
Roll dough thin and cut into diamond shapes.
Press a cross-hatch pattern on each piece.
Place cookies on a lined baking tray.
Preheat the oven to a moderate temperature.
Bake until edges are lightly golden.
Remove and let cool slightly on the tray.
Heat honey and a splash of water on the stovetop.
Simmer until the mixture thickens slightly.
Brush or dip warm cookies in the syrup.

swaps.why: Shop lacks a fryer; baking achieves a similar crisp texture without oil immersion.
Sesame oil can be hard to find; neutral oil keeps the honey flavor pure.

hooks: Sweet, sticky, and baked not fried.
Korean honey cookies meet Singapore cafe vibes.
Try the new glazed ginger cookie treat.
plan.caption: We baked our way to a new classic. Our Yakgwa is now a soft, honey-glazed cookie, perfect with your pistachio latte. #yogakwa #dessert
